---
name: Paper fixture / extraction failure
about: Report a paper the extractor handles badly (most valuable!)
labels: fixture, extraction
---

**Paper identifier:** arXiv id / DOI / attachment

**What the paper actually specifies** (quote + section/page):
- e.g. `learning rate: 0.0001 (§5.3, p.8)`

**What Paper2Bench extracted:**
- e.g. `training.learning_rate: unspecified`

**Failure type:**
- [ ] missed claim
- [ ] wrong value
- [ ] wrong evidence status
- [ ] conflicting sources not surfaced
- [ ] other

**Willing to add the fixture yourself?** See CONTRIBUTING.md — fixtures with expected claims are the highest-value contributions.
